method: Re-ran the dependency-free audit script after the Plan-Execute and ReAct lesson rewrites. It compiled all 7 currently published Python fences in the five targeted lessons, ran the remaining structured scorers, checked usage counters, and invoked the archived historical checker with false-positive answers. Plan-Execute DAG/conditional-routing validation is independently covered by exp-agent-paradigms-plan-execute-w6-20261021. No provider or network calls.
limitations: Historical model responses and per-run traces remain unavailable, so historical accuracy and token totals cannot be recomputed.
Local fixtures validate only their stated deterministic contracts; they do not test live providers, production authorization, side effects, or billing.
The dedicated Plan-Execute verifier covers local DAG validation and host routing only; it does not establish model planning quality or framework runtime behavior.
